question: On the v36 tree, does counter model v3 (strengths and counters refit toward a19-counter-draft-v1 on 13,605 games: the 6,549 v34/v35 self-play games of November 25 and the 7,056 fights of the v35 Premium snapshot) gain points over v1 and over v2 for a Spymaster seat where it changes the seat's army, without costing a Scout seat or the human-history guard?
decisionRule: Counter model v3 against v1 and v2, screen MV4 (AI against AI, three arms) and its human guard MV4G, on the v36 tree.
Written before any game of MV4 or MV4G ran and before any result of MV3 was read (MV3 is running; a 15-family smoke
on seed 2611253399 checked the scripts), November 25, 2026, 20:29Z.
Why: the owner asked to collect a Premium snapshot and use it ("you can just collect premium snapshot and use it i
guess"; "once snap is there, we can basically pick very nicely in first two doctrines"). The v35 snapshot (7,056
fights, 7 cohorts, maps 1/3/4) was collected; on it, creature strengths, counters, synergies and artifacts predict
held-out fights, while creature x map, synergy x map and artifact x map terms do not (development lookups). v3 refits
the counter model's strengths and counters toward v1 on 13,605 games (tonight's 6,549 self-play games and the
snapshot's 7,056). On the 59 human battery games (out of sample for every model), ranking the level-4 options
against the human's real army: rank correlation v1 +0.244, v2 +0.283, v3 +0.308; the top option minus production's
v1 +1.64, v2 +3.65, v3 +4.24 points per game. v2 (MV1's refit, self-play only) predicted the snapshot's armies worse
than v1 (log loss 0.6443 against 0.6394).
Tree: origin server 9705f5e48d3a4033e217f0a4ce2b9bc137dee3cf (profile v36) with common 19f3c39c (as pinned), plus
research-only files: the draft harness with hooks model_v2 and model_v3 (draft_guard.ts sha256 ae391b835b030dfa...), the game-id
override and the counter-model research seam. Arms for the candidate seat: production (v1), model_v2
(counter_model_v2.json 07c56c687e635814..., MV1/MV3's model) and model_v3 (counter_model_v3.json daef6836ce681795...).
MV4 populations (fresh seeds, the opponent's doctrine drawn live, both seats): S4 1,000 drafted families from seed
2611253401 (Spymaster seat), C4 400 families from seed 2611253501 (Scout seat). Stage 1 drafts the three arms; stage 2
plays each distinct army of every case where an arm changed the candidate's army (identical arms reuse one game), deep
fit, same seeds, in 48 shards (this Mac 0-13, x3d 14-27, basenode 28-47 when the client session can spare it).
MV4G: the owner-history games re-drafted with model_v3 against production's re-draft (27 changed games, 240 tasks per
arm), each changed army against the human's replayed setup, paired with production's army; on this tree; as MV1G.
Reported (analyze3.py): per stratum v3 - v1, v3 - v2 and v2 - v1 per changed case, families weighted equally, 95% from
10,000 family resamples; quality errors; v3 - v1 by the opponent's doctrine (report).
Bars: v3 is the adoption candidate (in place of v2) when S4's v3 - v1 lower bound is above 0, S4's v3 - v2 estimate is
above 0, C4's v3 - v1 lower bound is at least -3, there are 0 quality errors in MV4 and MV4G, and MV4G's estimate is at
least -2 per game. If v3 fails and MV3 passes, v2 stays the candidate.
decisionRuleBytes: the decisionRule lines joined with newlines plus a final newline
